item.title: Winegar steps down as Fishers boys basketball coach
item.description: Garrett Winegar has resigned as head coach of Fishers High School boys basketball team to join the coaching staff of Iowa United Prep, after leading the Tigers to a 132-25 record and a Class 4A state championship in 2024.

item.title: Felon found guilty of Plainfield road rage shooting injuring pregnant woman
item.description: Former Indianapolis resident Curtis Cutler, 40, was found guilty March 17, 2026, of attempted murder, aggravated battery, criminal recklessness, and unlawful possession of a firearm by a serious violent offender for a 2023 road rage shooting that injured a pregnant woman and her unborn child.

item.title: Danville police officer injured while directing traffic for Paddy’s 5K Run
item.description: A Danville police officer sustained minor injuries after being run over by a civilian vehicle while directing traffic for the Danville Parks & Recreation Paddy's 5k Run and Walk.

item.title: Indiana DNR introduces invasive carp harvest permit to protect native fish
item.description: The Indiana Department of Natural Resources has created a free invasive carp harvest permit to encourage commercial fishing and large-scale removal of invasive carp species that have been negatively impacting native fish populations.

item.title: Gov. Braun provides update on potential Bears stadium move to Indiana
item.description: Indiana Gov. Mike Braun gave an update on the potential Bears move to northwest Indiana from Chicago's Soldier Field, noting that the state's proposal has gained attention due to factors including the Indiana University Hoosiers' recent national college football championship win.

item.title: Major interstate proposal in downtown Indianapolis could create new urban spaces
item.description: The Southeast Gateway Study proposes transforming parts of I-65 and I-70 in downtown Indianapolis into new space for parks, housing, and businesses, funded by the Indiana Department of Transportation.

item.title: 11 suspects arrested in Shelby County sting of child-sex offenders
item.description: A three-day sting operation in Shelbyville resulted in 11 arrests and the rescue of an infant from sexual abuse, with the help of 75 officers from 21 local, state, and federal agencies.
